root_idea.summary: The root expresses two attested ideas: directing oneself toward a relied-upon object or person, and firmness or solidity.
root_idea.development: The first branch yields seeking, recourse, and the designation of a lord upon whom affairs depend; the second yields hard or elevated terrain and solid things. Quran-focused interpretation of الصمد combines divine recourse with freedom from bodily need.

senses.definition: The sovereign Lord to whom all turn in their needs and upon whom affairs ultimately depend.
senses.usage_conditions: A divine designation in the Quran, expressing recourse, reliance, and ultimate lordship rather than merely physical direction.

senses.definition: The non-hollow, non-nourished divine One, independent of bodily needs.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quranic theological interpretation that contrasts God with beings subject to nourishment and bodily functions; it is distinct from the material sense “solid, not hollow.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To direct oneself toward, seek, pursue, or have recourse to a person or thing; to aim at it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with constructions such as صمد إليه, صمد له, and صمد الأمر; it can also describe facing or pointing directly toward a target.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or beat someone with a staff or stick.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction with a person as object and a staff or stick as the instrument.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set up or erect a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction distinct from the directional sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the sun, to scorch a person’s face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression صمدت الشمس وجهه.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a stopper or cover into or over the mouth of a flask or bottle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use referring to sealing a vessel with a صِمَاد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tend or repair repeatedly or frequently; said of several people, to tend or repair someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II intensifies or distributes the tending action relative to the Form I use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wind a piece of cloth or a kerchief around the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction involving a صِمَاد, a head cloth or kerchief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend with someone in combat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III denotes mutual engagement in fighting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rest or lay an affair upon someone; to entrust it to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an affair as the object and a person as the one upon whom responsibility is placed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Elevated, rugged, hard, or firm ground, including a low rugged part of a mountain that produces trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A terrain term covering several closely related kinds of firm or rugged land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lord, chief, or person to whom one resorts in exigencies; one whose authority is obeyed and upon whom affairs depend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe a human chief or other relied-upon person, apart from the specifically Quranic divine designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A being who continues forever or remains after creatures perish; in a related theological description, the creator of all things on whom nothing depends.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical theological characterization of the term, kept distinct here from the Quran-attested senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Solid and not hollow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to material things in this sense; the cited lexical discussion explicitly excludes applying this usage to God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: High or elevated; figuratively, a man above whom there is no superior.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The elevated and pre-eminent applications belong to the same adjectival branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who neither thirsts nor hungers in war.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of endurance in warfare.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A people having no trade, occupation, or means of livelihood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective description of people lacking an occupation or livelihood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rock firmly embedded in the earth, level with or somewhat above its surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to an exposed, firmly fixed rock rather than loose stone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that has been covered but has not conceived.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stopper or skin cover for the mouth of a flask or bottle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the vessel’s stopper or covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloth or kerchief wound around the head, beneath or instead of a turban.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A clothing term distinct from the stopper sense of صِمَادٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A named idol worshipped by the tribe of ʿĀd.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper cultic designation in the cited lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Applied to a house or tent that has been repaired repeatedly or by many persons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of a repeatedly repaired structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hard thing lacking softness or fragility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival application to a hard or unyielding object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that endures cold, drought, or barren land while continuing to yield milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal term emphasizing endurance and continued milk production.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick or rough, and high, overtopping, or prominent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description combining substantial form with elevation or prominence.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Directional, purposive, and aiming uses are represented together.
Directly facing is covered by the directional sense.
Pointing toward is covered by the directional sense.
Springing or moving toward a target is covered by the directional sense.

cautions: The Quranic interpretation “non-hollow” is a theological explanation of الصمد and should not be conflated with the separately attested material adjective “solid, not hollow.”
